name: 1984 (VST3)
description: A vintage analog polysynth built the way the big ones were: eight voices, each of two complete ranks with their own oscillator, resonant high-pass, resonant low-pass, filter envelope and amplifier envelope. Brass, strings, choir, leads and the stranger things: hard sync, poly-mod, a ring modulator, unison. Then everything goes to tape before it goes to the hall: wow, flutter, saturation, age, dropouts, a VHS mode, a three-phase ensemble and a formant choir. Forty factory patches. It is built to sound like a late night in 1984.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260923.1 · free download · 8 voices × 2 ranks · CS / ladder filters · tape, VHS, ensemble, choir, hall · 40 patches · BWFX rack · manual included.
